_about: The ad-to-site data (SITE-GOALS §4): hooks and page variants, so a new ad needs no code change. ?h=<id> puts the ad's first line in the headline slot (home and /breathe) and preselects its session on /breathe; unknown ids are ignored. line_en: the headline (7 words or fewer). sub_en: the one line under it ({guide} is the session's narrator). world: the colour world the ad ends in (the /breathe first frame). card_en, edge_sub_en, start_f: /breathe variant f only. Swedish lines (line_sv) not written yet. variants: what ?v= may pick on each page; anything else falls back to the default.

coffee.sub_en: Try 6 minutes of breathing with {guide} instead. Free, no app needed.

email.sub_en: 6 minutes of breathing with {guide} first. Free, no app needed.

parked.line_en: Parked outside. Not ready to go in.
parked.sub_en: Take 6 minutes with {guide} first. Free, no app needed.

slowest.line_en: The slowest breath of your day.
slowest.sub_en: 6 minutes of slow breathing with {guide}. Free, no app needed.

exhale.sub_en: Find out in 6 minutes with {guide}. Free, no app needed.

rate.sub_en: Ask again after 6 minutes with {guide}. Free, no app needed.

keepup.line_en: Can you keep up with this?
keepup.sub_en: Fast breaths, then a long hold. 6 minutes with {guide}, free.
keepup.edge_sub_en: Each round builds, then a long hold. 6 minutes with {guide}, free.

night.sub_en: 6 slow minutes with {guide}. Fine to do lying down. Free.

variants._about: ?v= picks a page variant for the A/B. Every event carries the variant actually shown (v).

options.eyes: the brand-film still (eyes closed): a right-hand panel on desktop, a top band on phones
options.land: a landscape instead (forest at dawn), no person

options.g1: g: one line, the sphere, Begin; swipe between the worlds (live since 29 Sep); ?v=g is the same
